name: Kingdom of Bau (1867–1869)
description: Three horizontal stripes of white, blue and red, with a crown in the upper hoist on the white stripe and a gold half-sun with rays on the blue.
history: Seru Epenisa Cakobau, the Vunivalu of Bau, was proclaimed king of Bau — styled Tui Viti — on 2 May 1867 with the backing of European settlers, and this flag was adopted for his kingdom. It gave way in 1869 to the arrangements that led to the united Kingdom of Fiji of 1871.
